title: Presentation-state certification — artifact identity is mandatory, the weak fallback is eliminated, and authority reaches the final UI state
author: Coder 2 (presentation layer)
directive: Operator directive R451-C2.4 (8 numbered requirements: eliminate the weak fallback; make artifact identity mandatory (the nine proofs); validate GLB format not just bytes; separate artifact discovery from artifact certification; make the required lineage mandatory (receipt.geometry_spec_sha256 exists + equality; artifact generation == receipt generation == current generation); carry authority through the final UI state (CONCEPTUAL/UNKNOWN explicit behavior at final visual readiness); the twelve-attack adversarial battery; do not expand C2 scope). Acceptance gate: R451-C2.4.
round_question: Can the presentation boundary be reached WITHOUT the recorded artifact identity chain — a filename that looks right, a stale CIO render verdict, a legacy boolean projection — and still claim visual readiness?
answer: NO — measured: every promotion now requires the certified identity chain from bytes; the CIO fallback can never produce visual_complete on either layer; and twelve independently authored forgery attempts each fail to promote the state.

req_1_fallback_eliminated.what: the weak current-state path is REMOVED: strict evaluator undecided -> CIO render fallback -> visual_complete can no longer happen. _renders_cause's PASS branch now returns geometry_available + the new typed cause legacy_render_unverified ('a historical render is recorded, but it predates (or bypasses) the verifiable identity chain — the presentation state is explicitly unverified') — readable ONLY as explicitly unverified historical state, never visual_complete (source-pinned: no return of visual_complete in the function body). The frontend's pre-C2.1 legacy fallback can NEVER resolve to VISUAL_READY either. Legacy data stays readable; nothing stale upgrades.

req_2_artifact_identity_mandatory.what: geometry_available requires ALL NINE proofs (new certified_canonical_glb + the contract's gate): canonical artifact exists AND non-zero AND a valid artifact identity exists AND the identity carries the required SHA AND SHA == actual bytes AND a generation ID exists AND the generation matches the current-generation anchor AND the authority is EXPLICIT (a recorded class from the identity documents — UNKNOWN is not explicit) AND no contradicting terminal failure. Missing any: not success. The new typed state geometry_unverified (vocabulary 6 -> 7) carries an artifact candidate whose certification is incomplete — never a failure, never a silent pass (Art. XXV). visual_input_ready now REQUIRES certification (the C2.3 byte-satisfiable-without-identity shortcut superseded, disclosed).

req_3_glb_format_validity.what: glb_format_check: deterministic, loader-free container proof (glTF magic + version 2 + declared length == file size). A correct hash over non-GLB bytes never certifies; truncated/padded containers fail. Enforced in the contract AND release-chain rung 1.

req_4_discovery_vs_certification.what: resolve_canonical_glb is the DIAGNOSTIC locator only — it locates candidates for diagnostics and record invariants; a filename that looks right never certifies. The authoritative path: recorded identity document (DESIGN_LINEAGE.json current generation / ARTIFACT_IDENTITY.glb_path) -> exact artifact -> measured SHA -> current generation. Filename-fallback candidates are reported as diagnostic_candidate, never certified.

req_5_mandatory_lineage.what: release chain rung invocation_receipt_identity now REQUIRES receipt.geometry_spec_sha256 to EXIST and equal the GEOMETRY_SPEC.json bytes (the C2.3-era lenient both-absent pass SUPERSEDED — an unprovable lineage is a failed rung, never a pass); NEW rung generation_identity: artifact generation == receipt generation == current generation. The chain is 7 -> 8 rungs; rung names stable for consumers.

req_6_authority_through_ui.what: the VISUAL_READY view carries engineeringAuthority; the badge maps (VISUAL_READY, ENGINEERING) -> 'Technology ready' (the ONLY path to that label), (VISUAL_READY, CONCEPTUAL) -> 'Conceptual model ready', (VISUAL_READY, UNKNOWN/absent) -> 'Visualization ready — geometry authority unverified'. A render is never the claim. geometry_unverified + legacy_render_unverified have their own closed-vocabulary labels and sentences (the cause vocabulary closes at nine); the strip carries blocked_class IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED / LEGACY_RENDER_UNVERIFIED; the design tab's note names the certification gap; the Engineering milestone never RECEIVES on an unverified artifact.

req_7_adversarial_battery.what: tests/test_r451_c24_certification.py — the TWELVE directive attacks each proven NOT to promote, plus positive controls, format unit attacks, discovery-vs-certification separation, fallback-elimination proofs (behavioral + source pins), one-evaluator coupling, and the clean-state byte-identical replay.

req_8_no_scope_expansion.what: no new visual models, no Blender work, no camera improvements, no materials, no cinematic rendering, no new renderer infrastructure, no new scientific rules — the round is exactly the certification contract, the fallback removal, and their batteries.
